about: Character names refused at creation and rename (server only). The same rules and lists as the account platform's usernames (UntitledAccountSystem src/lib/usernames.ts, copied 2026-11-25; keep them in step by hand). blocked_anywhere: refused anywhere in the name, after undoing look-alike digits. blocked_words: refused only as the whole name or one space- or digit-separated part, so 'class' and 'grape' pass. reserved_*: names that could pass for staff or the game. Words in chat_filter.json are refused too, as whole words. See docs/architecture/backend.md, 'Character names'.
